description: This file defines the IQueueCache interface within the Orleans.Streams namespace, outlining methods for managing stream message caching, including adding messages, purging, retrieving cursors, and checking pressure status.

classes.name: IQueueCache
classes.description: Interface defining cache management operations for stream messages in Orleans.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds message batches to the cache.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge items from the cache, returning success status and purged items.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor to read messages from the cache starting at a specified stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is under memory or resource pressure.
